args.program:
(let [definition (dabstep.payments/fraud-definition)
      agg (loop [cursor nil totals {}]
            (let [page (dabstep.payments/read-page cursor ["ip_country" "eur_amount" "has_fraudulent_dispute"])
                  rows (get page "rows")
                  next-cursor (get page "next_cursor")
                  updated (reduce (fn [m row]
                                    (let [country (get row 0)
                                          amount (or (get row 1) 0.0)
                                          fraud? (get row 2)
                                          old (get m country {:fraud 0.0 :total 0.0})]
                                      (assoc m country {:fraud (+ (:fraud old) (if fraud? amount 0.0))
                                                        :total (+ (:total old) amount)})))
                                  totals rows)]
              (if next-cursor (recur next-cursor updated) updated)))
      countries (mapv (fn [[country values]] {"ip_country" country
                                               "fraudulent_volume" (:fraud values)
                                               "total_volume" (:total values)}) agg)
      problems ["The analysis ranked countries by fraud rate (fraudulent volume divided by total volume), not by fraudulent volume, so its stated ranking method does not match a top-volume question."
                "The recheck output omitted the required problems field and did not independently establish the benchmark fraud definition; the measured volumes here use has_fraudulent_dispute and eur_amount."]]
  (println definition)
  (return {"countries" countries "problems" problems}))

(let [stats (loop [cursor nil totals {}]
              (let [page (dabstep.payments/read-page cursor ["ip_country" "eur_amount" "has_fraudulent_dispute"])
                    totals2 (reduce (fn [acc row]
                                      (let [country (nth row 0)
                                            amount (or (nth row 1) 0)
                                            fraudulent (nth row 2)
                                            prior (get acc country [0 0])]
                                        (if country
                                          (assoc acc country [(+ (nth prior 0) (if fraudulent amount 0))
                                                               (+ (nth prior 1) amount)])
                                          acc)))
                                    totals
                                    (get page "rows"))]
                (if (get page "next_cursor")
                  (recur (get page "next_cursor") totals2)
                  totals2)))
      countries (mapv (fn [[country volumes]]
                        {"ip_country" country
                         "fraudulent_volume" (double (nth volumes 0))
                         "total_volume" (double (nth volumes 1))})
                      stats)]
  (return {"countries" countries
           "problems" ["The analyzer discarded the first data row on every page by applying (rest ...) to rows, even though read-page rows are already data vectors; its aggregates are therefore incomplete. The fraud definition is fraudulent volume divided by total volume, so the candidate must be chosen by that ratio rather than by raw fraudulent volume."]}))
